previous_evidence.excerpt: Ordered from Grab because I was too tired to cook. While eating I scrolled past an article about plastic waste in the Java Sea. Closed it, kept eating from the styrofoam container.
Rainy morning. The uncle at the kopi stall asked about my daughter. Drank my coffee and watched the wet road for a while before heading to the MRT.
I didn't laugh but I also didn't say anything.
